newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean, oil, meal firm on limited supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean, oil, meal firm on limited supply.

text.p: Soybean prices firmed 100-150 rupees per tonne on limited arrivals in central Indian markets on Friday, traders said.
Soyoil solvent was up 200 rupees per tonne.

Soymeal prices too turned firm amid tight supplies on export enquiries. Soymeal yellow was quoted at $269-270 per tonne. Rapeseed extraction was offered at $135 per tonne in export deals. Rapeseed extraction was quoted at 4,600 rupees (f.o.r) Bedibunder and at 4,550-4,575 rupees (f.o.r) Bhavnagar.
